name: castdesk
description: CastDesk - mirror, extend and control screens between PCs, phones and tablets over USB or a local network. No internet required.

scripts.test: npm run test -w @castdesk/shared && npm run test -w @castdesk/host && npm run test -w @castdesk/desktop
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:client && npm run dev -w @castdesk/desktop
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:client && npm run dist -w @castdesk/desktop
scripts.build:exe: npm run build:client && npm run dist:win:exe -w @castdesk/desktop
